# OBSBOT sub-actions

## AI tracking lock (Tiny)

Locks AI tracking onto the subject now in view, or lets go again. For Tiny cameras.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Lock keeps following the current subject. Unlock lets the camera choose again. Toggle flips the current state. Options: Lock, Unlock, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.aiLocked%` | True when tracking is locked now |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.aiLock`</small>

## Get camera state

Reads the camera's current zoom, angle, AI lock and more into variables you can use in later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.deviceIndex%` | Which camera is selected, counting from 0 (0 is the first camera) |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |
| `%obsbot.awake%` | True when the camera is awake |
| `%obsbot.zoom%` | The zoom, 0 to 100 percent |
| `%obsbot.fovDegrees%` | The field of view, like "86°" |
| `%obsbot.pitch%` | How far the camera is tilted up or down, in degrees |
| `%obsbot.yaw%` | How far the camera is turned left or right, in degrees |
| `%obsbot.aiLocked%` | True when AI tracking is locked on a subject |
| `%obsbot.deviceCount%` | How many cameras are connected |
| `%obsbot.fov%` | The field of view as a number (0 is 86°, 1 is 78°, 2 is 65°) |
| `%obsbot.isConnected%` | True when Cuebot is connected to OBSBOT Center |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.getState`</small>

## Go to preset position

Moves the camera to one of its three saved positions (presets).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Preset** | Which saved position to go to: 1, 2 or 3. Options: 1, 2, 3. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Camera series** | Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong. Options: Auto, Tiny, Tail. Starts as: `Auto`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.triggerPreset`</small>

## Lock pan / tilt axis (Tail 2)

Locks the Tail 2 so it cannot turn left-right (Pan) or up-down (Tilt), or lets it move again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Axis** | Pan is left and right. Tilt is up and down. Options: Pan, Tilt. Starts as: `Pan`. |
| **State** | Lock stops it from moving that way. Unlock lets it move again. Options: Lock, Unlock. Starts as: `Lock`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setAxisLock`</small>

## Move gimbal

Turns or tilts the camera in a direction, like moving it by hand. Choose Stop to stop it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Direction** | Which way to move. Choose Stop to stop all movement. Options: Up, Down, Left, Right, Stop. Starts as: `Up`. |
| **Speed (1-100)** | How fast to move, from 1 (slow) to 100 (fast). Starts as: `50`. |
| **Duration (ms, optional)** | How long to move, in milliseconds (1000 is one second). Leave empty to keep moving until you run a Stop step. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.moveGimbal`</small>

## Recording

Starts or stops a recording made by the camera or by OBSBOT Center.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Recording** | PC recording and High-fps recording are made on your computer. Camera recording is made by the camera itself and only works on a Tail camera. Options: PC recording, High-fps recording, Camera recording (Tail). Starts as: `PC recording`. |
| **State** | Start begins recording, Stop ends it. Options: Start, Stop. Starts as: `Start`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.recording`</small>

## Reset gimbal

Turns the camera back to its centre position.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.resetGimbal`</small>

## Select camera

Picks which OBSBOT camera the next steps control. Only needed if you have more than one camera.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Camera** | The camera number, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Starts as: `1`. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.selectDevice`</small>

## Send OSC message

For experts: sends your own OSC message (a short control message that OBSBOT understands). Use it for camera features the other steps do not cover.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Address** | The message address, like /OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom. See OBSBOT's own OSC list for the addresses. |
| **Arguments** | The values for the message, separated by spaces or commas, like "50". Whole numbers, decimals, true/false and words are all fine. Leave empty if it needs none. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.sendOsc`</small>

## Set AI mode

Chooses what the camera's AI follows, like the whole body or just the face.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **AI mode** | A mode number. For Tiny 2: 0 off, 1 normal, 2 upper body, 3 close-up, 4 headless, 5 lower body, 6 desk, 7 whiteboard, 8 hand, 9 group. Other models use other numbers. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Camera series** | Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong. Options: Auto, Tiny, Tail. Starts as: `Auto`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setAiMode`</small>

## Set auto framing (Meet)

Makes the camera crop and follow people on its own. For OBSBOT Meet cameras.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Auto framing** | Disable turns it off. Single follows one person. Group fits everyone in the picture. Options: Disable, Single, Group. Starts as: `Single`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setAutoFraming`</small>

## Set field of view

Changes how wide the camera sees (its field of view). A bigger angle shows more of the room.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Field of view** | The angle: 86° (widest), 78° or 65° (narrowest). Options: 86°, 78°, 65°. Starts as: `86°`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setView`</small>

## Set gimbal position

Turns the camera to an exact left-right and up-down angle.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Pan (°, -129..129)** | How far to turn left or right, in degrees. 0 is the middle, minus is left. About -129 to 129; a Tail 2 connected straight to Cuebot allows -159 to 159. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Pitch (°, -59..59)** | How far to tilt up or down, in degrees. 0 is level. About -59 to 59; a Tail 2 connected straight to Cuebot allows -62 to 62. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Speed (0-90)** | How fast to turn, from 0 to 90. Starts as: `50`. |
| **Send decimals** | Tick to send angles with decimals, like 12.5, instead of whole degrees. Works only through OBSBOT Center. Starts as: `False`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setGimbalPosition`</small>

## Set image setting

Changes one picture setting of the camera, such as focus, exposure or white balance (the colour warmth).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Setting** | Which picture setting to change. Options: Auto focus, Manual focus, Tail focus mode, Auto exposure, Exposure compensation, Shutter speed, ISO, Auto white balance, Color temperature, White balance shift, Red/blue gain. Starts as: `Auto exposure`. |
| **Value** | The new value. Auto settings: 1 is auto, 0 is manual. Manual focus: 0-100. Exposure compensation: -30 to 30. ISO: 100-6400. Color temperature: 2000-10000. Shutter speed: like 100 for 1/100. |
| **Second value** | Only for Tail focus mode, White balance shift and Red/blue gain, which need two numbers. Leave empty for the others. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setImage`</small>

## Set mirror

Flips the picture left to right, like a mirror.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mirror** | On flips the picture. Off shows it the normal way round. Options: On, Off. Starts as: `On`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setMirror`</small>

## Set tracking mode (Tiny)

Chooses how a Tiny camera follows you: Headroom keeps space above your head, Standard follows you, Motion follows movement.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tracking mode** | Headroom, Standard or Motion. Tiny 2, Tiny 2 Lite and Tiny SE only have Standard and Motion. Options: Headroom, Standard, Motion. Starts as: `Standard`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setTrackingMode`</small>

## Set tracking speed

Sets how quickly the camera follows you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Speed** | A number. Tiny 3 and Tail Air: 0 slow, 1 standard, 2 fast. Tail 2: 0 to 5, from very lazy to automatic. For one axis on a Tail 2: 1 to 10. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Axis** | Both changes everything at once. Pan is left-right and Tilt is up-down; picking one is only for the Tail 2. Options: Both, Pan, Tilt. Starts as: `Both`. |
| **Camera series** | Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong. Options: Auto, Tiny, Tail. Starts as: `Auto`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setTrackingSpeed`</small>

## Set virtual background (Meet)

Changes the background behind you without a green screen. For OBSBOT Meet cameras.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Background** | Disable shows your real room. Blur blurs what is behind you. Green screen and Replacement are the camera's other background modes; set their look in OBSBOT Center. Options: Disable, Blur, Green screen, Replacement. Starts as: `Blur`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setVirtualBackground`</small>

## Set zoom

Zooms the camera to a set amount.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Zoom (0-100)** | How far to zoom, from 0 (widest) to 100 (closest). Starts as: `0`. |
| **Speed (optional, 0-11)** | How fast to zoom, 0 to 11 (higher is faster, 0 is the normal speed). Leave empty to jump straight there. Only newer cameras support it. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.setZoom`</small>

## Standard mode (Meet)

Switches an OBSBOT Meet camera to its standard mode.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.standardMode`</small>

## Take snapshot

Takes a still photo with the camera.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Snapshot** | PC snapshot is taken on your computer. Camera snapshot is taken by the camera itself and only works on a Tail camera. Options: PC snapshot, Camera snapshot (Tail). Starts as: `PC snapshot`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.snapshot`</small>

## Wake / sleep camera

Wakes the camera up or puts it to sleep. Handy to switch the camera off when you end your stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Wake wakes it, Sleep puts it to sleep, Toggle flips the current state. Options: Wake, Sleep, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.awake%` | True when the camera is awake now |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.wakeSleep`</small>

## Zoom to maximum / minimum

Zooms the camera all the way in or all the way out.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Zoom** | Max zooms all the way in. Min zooms all the way out. Options: Max, Min. Starts as: `Max`. |
| **Camera** | Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center. |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.zoomLimit`</small>
